title: UA Vehicle Registry — Normalized Record
description: Schema for a single record in the normalized UA vehicle registry Parquet snapshots (v2.0). From the 2026-04 snapshot rows are no longer aggregated, so the identifier is the single-valued `record_id` instead of the `record_ids` array. From the 2026-05 snapshot the source registry stopped publishing the registration plate and the owner's KOATUU code, so `reg_addr_koatuu`, `n_reg_new`, `n_reg_latin` and `is_valid_plate` are omitted from those files entirely rather than emitted as all-null columns. Consumers should read columns by name and treat any of them as optional.

record_id.description: Source record ID. Present from the 2026-04 snapshot onward, where each row is a single source record.

record_ids.description: Array of source record IDs aggregated into this row. Present only in snapshots up to 2026-03, which were built with GROUP BY + ARRAY_AGG. Superseded by `record_id`.

person_type.description: Type of owner. P = natural person (фізична особа), J = legal entity (юридична особа).

reg_addr_koatuu.description: KOATUU code of the owner's registered address. Stored as string to preserve leading zeros. Absent from snapshots from 2026-05 onward: the source registry no longer publishes it.

oper_code.description: Numeric code of the registration operation.

oper_name.description: Human-readable name of the registration operation.

d_reg.description: Date of the registration operation (ISO 8601: YYYY-MM-DD).

dep_code.description: Code of the service center (department). String, not integer, to preserve leading zeros. From 2026-05 the source no longer supplies it directly; it is recovered from the service center name, and is null where no match exists.

vin.description: Vehicle Identification Number. Null for records predating July 2021 (VIN column absent in source).

fuel.description: Fuel type (e.g., БЕНЗИН, ДИЗЕЛЬНЕ ПАЛИВО, ЕЛЕКТРО).

power_kwt.description: Engine power in kW. Present from the 2026-04 snapshot onward. The source registry supplies it from 2026-05; for earlier registrations it is carried over from a later record of the same VIN, and is null where no such record exists.

n_reg_new.description: Vehicle registration plate number (new format). Absent from snapshots from 2026-05 onward: the source registry no longer publishes it.

secondary_fuel.description: Secondary fuel type (e.g., ГАЗ for LPG/CNG vehicles).

n_reg_latin.description: Vehicle registration plate transliterated to Latin characters. Absent from snapshots from 2026-05 onward: derived from `n_reg_new`, which the source no longer publishes.

is_valid_plate.description: Whether the registration plate passes format validation. Absent from snapshots from 2026-05 onward: with no plate in the source, validity is unknown rather than false.

raw_vin.description: Original VIN as received from source. Null for records before 2021.

is_valid_vin.description: Whether the VIN passes checksum and format validation. Null for records before 2021.
